agent_report.summary: Implemented Issue #46: replaced the six inconsistent panel border styles (dashed/dotted/double) with one coherent accent system (only Priorities keeps a distinguishing top border), self-hosted Source Sans 3 (OFL, ~30.6KB, regular+bold woff2) with system-stack fallback and font-display:swap, and a small :root type-scale token set for the date heading/panel headings/body/meta hierarchy. Verified all required contrast pairs already pass WCAG with the existing palette (no re-tuning needed). Added 8 new Playwright tests covering border styles, accent count, font hosting/no-third-party-host, font-load-failure resilience, type-scale hierarchy, contrast, and font weight budget — full suite (140/140) passes unmodified otherwise. Documented reasoning in DECISIONS.md. Opened PR #47 (closes #46).
